description: Block until a submitted task finishes (or the timeout), polling every 5 seconds, then return its result. Use right after vibekit_submit_task when you want the final result inline.

taskId.description: Task ID to wait for (from vibekit_submit_task)

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait (default 300; the remote connector caps this at 120)

name: vibekit_wait_for_task

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Final task state after polling: completed or failed, with result details.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Wait for Task
